messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: error with installing mirtCAT package on Mac
parts:
Looks like a different error, one indicating that you are missing a fortran compiler. This apparently is common with Macs (I made a note here, https://github.com/philchalmers/mirt), so put the following in your terminal to install the compiler and try again:

curl -O http://r.research.att.com/libs/gfortran-4.8.2-darwin13.tar.bz2
sudo tar fvxz gfortran-4.8.2-darwin13.tar.bz2 -C /

Phil
